svg.title: Five Revenue Lanes, One Comparable Annual Dollar Unit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-five-monetization-lane-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Revenue Lanes, One Comparable Annual Dollar Unit; subtitle: Illustrative lane allocations sum to the canonical $362,500 Base Case.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Every bar measures annual recognized operator revenue in USD, not margin, player deposits, or return on wagering capital. The first two bars are SaaS subscriptions; the third is a separately assessed software-compensation lane; the final two are distinct affiliate cohorts with distinct settlement records.; caption: $150,000 + $60,000 + $12,500 + $90,000 + $50,000 = $362,500. These allocations are an illustrative bridge, not externally verified partner rates or current program availability.; stages: label: Core terminal subscriptions; value: $150,000 annual SaaS revenue; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: 250 average paying subscribers at $50 monthly generate $150,000 annually. Average subscribers already incorporate churn and replacements. Deliver market comparison, timestamps, and fee normalization without account custody or customer order submission.; label: Professional analytics subscriptions; value: $60,000 annual SaaS revenue; numeric value: 60000.0; detail: 50 additional average paying subscribers at $100 monthly generate $60,000 annually. Keep these subscribers separate from the core tier. Price export capacity, saved analytic views, and alert delivery rather than promising trading profits or personalized investment outcomes.; label: Permitted builder compensation; value: $12,500 annual software revenue; numeric value: 12500.0; detail: Assume 25 contract-defined software-service milestones earning $500 each under an expressly permitted arrangement. This is a modeling unit, not a claim that any named venue offers this program. Do not recognize revenue until terms, activity classification, and acceptance evidence support it.; label: Seasonally adjusted CPA commissions; value: $90,000 annual affiliate revenue; numeric value: 90000.0; detail: 120 potential payable depositors at $900 imply $108,000 before a modeled 20-event post-NFL budget reduction. The remaining 100 produce $90,000. Subtract the separately budgeted $30,000 CPA acquisition cost for $60,000 contribution before shared delivery and overhead.; label: Settled NGR commissions; value: $50,000 annual affiliate revenue; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: An illustrative $80,000 preliminary commission entitlement, not casino-wide gaming revenue, falls to $50,000 after $18,000 admin and bonus allocations and $12,000 carryover. Subtract $10,000 allocated acquisition cost for $40,000 contribution before shared costs; retain partner-level carryover ledgers.

text.title: Five Revenue Lanes, One Comparable Annual Dollar Unit
text.tspan: Five Revenue Lanes, One Comparable Annual Dollar Unit

circle.title: label: Core terminal subscriptions; value: $150,000 annual SaaS revenue; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: 250 average paying subscribers at $50 monthly generate $150,000 annually. Average subscribers already incorporate churn and replacements. Deliver market comparison, timestamps, and fee normalization without account custody or customer order submission.

label: Professional analytics subscriptions; value: $60,000 annual SaaS revenue; numeric value: 60000.0; detail: 50 additional average paying subscribers at $100 monthly generate $60,000 annually. Keep these subscribers separate from the core tier. Price export capacity, saved analytic views, and alert delivery rather than promising trading profits or personalized investment outcomes.

label: Permitted builder compensation; value: $12,500 annual software revenue; numeric value: 12500.0; detail: Assume 25 contract-defined software-service milestones earning $500 each under an expressly permitted arrangement. This is a modeling unit, not a claim that any named venue offers this program. Do not recognize revenue until terms, activity classification, and acceptance evidence support it.

label: Seasonally adjusted CPA commissions; value: $90,000 annual affiliate revenue; numeric value: 90000.0; detail: 120 potential payable depositors at $900 imply $108,000 before a modeled 20-event post-NFL budget reduction. The remaining 100 produce $90,000. Subtract the separately budgeted $30,000 CPA acquisition cost for $60,000 contribution before shared delivery and overhead.

label: Settled NGR commissions; value: $50,000 annual affiliate revenue; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: An illustrative $80,000 preliminary commission entitlement, not casino-wide gaming revenue, falls to $50,000 after $18,000 admin and bonus allocations and $12,000 carryover. Subtract $10,000 allocated acquisition cost for $40,000 contribution before shared costs; retain partner-level carryover ledgers.

text.title: Assumptions: Every bar measures annual recognized operator revenue in USD, not margin, player deposits, or return on wagering capital. The first two bars are SaaS subscriptions; the third is a separately assessed software-compensation lane; the final two are distinct affiliate cohorts with distinct settlement records.
